第1章 每日一卦未卜先知（第1页）
屋内，一个少年躺在床上，无神的看着天花板。
“可你一死了之，这烂摊子都丢给我了……”
“马上过冬，家中口粮一点不剩，这是刚穿越过来，就要被饿死的节奏啊！”
少年名叫江尘，本是二十一世纪普通社畜一名。
回家途中去救一对落水的母子，人救起来了，自己却没上来。
醒来时，就成三山村村民，与他同名同姓……
本来，能重活一世，他还是挺高兴的。
可看完原主的记忆，却不由气的骂人。
原主十八岁，母亲早亡，家中还有老爹，兄嫂，以及侄儿侄女。
大概是因为母亲走的时候原主年纪尚小，就渐渐被老爹宠坏了。
他到了十八，还是游手好闲，整日瞎混，偷鸡摸狗。
按村子里的人说，就是个标准的‘泼皮无赖’！
今年是收成不好，家中没什么存粮。
老爹上山打猎又摔伤了腿，治伤花了不少钱，如今还要拄拐，家中日子愈发紧巴。
可只因为女神‘陈花’的暗示，加上身边‘兄弟’撺掇。
原主就偷了家中过冬的存粮，去城中换了一只簪子准备送给陈花当定情信物。
剩下的钱，换了酒肉，和好兄弟张三坡吃了个肚圆。

归家时，又醉倒在村外小道旁，于寒风积雪中躺了一夜。
昨日被路人发现，才被哥哥江田背了回来。
在家躺了一天，醒来后，身体里，已经另一个江尘了。
而且，那用口粮换回来的银簪也不见了踪影。
许是被经过的路人摸走了，也许是路上遗失。
但簪子已经不重要了，就算找回来，再去典当也换不回六口人过冬的口粮。
“荒年，没粮……这里的冬天，是真的会死人的。”
江尘一时不知如何应对，学着曾看过的小说主角一样……制盐、酿酒吗？
可私盐犯法，酿酒又需要大量的粮食，他现在都快饿死了，哪里去找粮。
正胡思乱想时，江尘忽然感觉胸前一热，随即一个古朴龟甲出现在前。
江尘看到这熟悉的龟甲，不由一愣。
他落水时，好像迷糊间摸到了什么，材质……好像就是一枚龟甲。
江尘睁眼细看，龟甲上布满荧光，其上还飘着一颗晦暗难明的星辰。
而于星辰和龟甲明暗交界处，写着【未卜】二字。
江尘呼吸瞬间急促了几分，这龟甲莫非能未卜先知……趋吉避凶！
江尘按住心中激动，伸手戳了戳龟甲。
哗啦一声，【未卜】二字变为【先知】

Chapter 1 A prediction of the unknown every day (Page 1)
Inside the house, a young man was lying on the bed, looking at the ceiling blankly.
"But as soon as you died, all this mess was left to me..."
"It's winter soon, and there is no food left at home. This is the rhythm of starving to death just after crossing over!"
The boy's name is Jiang Chen, and he is an ordinary social beast in the 21st century.
On the way home, I went to rescue a mother and son who fell into the water. They were rescued, but I didn't come out.
When he wakes up, he becomes a villager in Sanshan Village, with the same name as him...
Originally, he was quite happy to be able to live another life.
But after reading the memory of the original owner, he couldn't help but curse him angrily.
The original owner was eighteen years old, his mother died young, and he still had his father, brother, sister-in-law, nephews and nieces at home.
Probably because the original owner was still young when his mother left, so he was gradually spoiled by his father.
When he reached eighteen, he was still idle, fooling around and stealing all day long.
According to the people in the village, he is a standard 'rogue'!
This year's harvest is not good, and there is little food left at home.
My father broke his leg while hunting in the mountains. It cost a lot of money to treat the injury. Now he has to use crutches, and life at home has become increasingly tight.
But only because of the hint from the goddess ‘Chen Hua’ and the encouragement from the ‘brothers’ around her.
The original owner stole the food stored in the family for the winter, went to the city to exchange for a hairpin, and prepared to give it to Chen Hua as a token of love.
The remaining money was exchanged for wine and meat, and I had a full meal with my good brother Zhang Sanpo.
When he returned home, he passed out drunk again on the side of the path outside the village, lying in the cold wind and snow all night.
Yesterday, he was discovered by passers-by and was carried back by his brother Jiang Tian.
After lying at home for a day, when I woke up, there was already another Jiang Chen in my body.
Moreover, the silver hairpin that was exchanged for rations was also missing.
Maybe it was touched by a passer-by, or maybe it was lost on the road.
But the hairpin is no longer important. Even if you find it, you can't pawn it back in exchange for the winter rations for six people.
"In lean years, without food...the winter here can really kill people."
Jiang Chen didn't know how to deal with it for a moment, so he imitated the protagonist of the novel he had read...making salt and brewing wine?
But smuggling salt is illegal, and winemaking requires a lot of food. He is starving to death now, where can he find food.
While he was thinking wildly, Jiang Chen suddenly felt a heat in his chest, and then a simple tortoise shell appeared in front of him.
Jiang Chen couldn't help but be startled when he saw this familiar tortoise shell.
When he fell into the water, he seemed to touch something in a daze. The material... seemed to be a tortoise shell.
Jiang Chen opened his eyes and took a closer look. The tortoise shell was covered with fluorescence, and there was an obscure star floating on it.
And at the junction of light and dark between the stars and the tortoise shell, the word "Unsure" is written.
Jiang Chen's breathing suddenly became a little faster. Could this tortoise shell be able to predict the future... Seek good luck and avoid bad luck?
Jiang Chen suppressed the excitement in his heart and reached out to poke the tortoise shell.
With a crash, the word "Unsure" changed into "Prophet"
